topic: 中東情勢が悪化、イエメン・サウジ周辺で攻撃続く
ledger_text:
[VERIFIED] F1: Hans Grundberg, the UN Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for Yemen, said Yemen had slid back into full-scale war over the preceding few weeks, with hostilities spreading across multiple frontlines.
  scope: Yemen; multiple frontlines
  conditions: 【主体】Hans Grundberg, Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen
  date_or_period: 9 October 2026; preceding few weeks
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: This is the Special Envoy’s characterization, not an independently established legal or military classification. 【背景】The Security Council met to discuss the situation in Yemen on 9 October 2026.

[VERIFIED] F2: The Special Envoy reported intense fighting in the highlands west and south of Taiz city and across into Lahj, and said fighting had intensified in Marib, al-Jawf and Hajjah.
  scope: Areas west and south of Taiz city, Lahj, Marib, al-Jawf and Hajjah
  conditions: 【主体】Hans Grundberg, Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen
  date_or_period: As reported on 9 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: The source describes these locations and fighting conditions but provides no casualty figures. 【背景】The report says the fighting followed Ansar Allah advances on Mokha and the coast along the Bab al-Mandab.

[VERIFIED] F3: The Yemeni Government launched what the Special Envoy described as a large-scale counter-offensive earlier that week and reported retaking areas around the Bab al-Mandab.
  scope: Areas around the Bab al-Mandab
  conditions: Retaking areas was reported by the Government, according to the Special Envoy. 【主体】The Government of Yemen
  date_or_period: Earlier in the week of 9 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: Attribute the reported territorial recapture to the Government; the source gives no more precise date or area list.

[VERIFIED] F4: The Special Envoy said Ansar Allah had carried out deadly attacks against civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.
  scope: Civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
  conditions: 【主体】Ansar Allah, as identified by the Special Envoy
  date_or_period: Reported on 9 October 2026; individual attack dates not specified
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: Attribute the claim to the Special Envoy; do not infer details beyond the statement.

[VERIFIED] F5: The Special Envoy said ongoing instability in the Middle East continued to affect dynamics in Yemen, while developments in Yemen in turn reverberated across the region.
  scope: Middle East and Yemen
  conditions: 【主体】Hans Grundberg, Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen
  date_or_period: 9 October 2026 statement
  causal_strength: CAUSAL_STATED_BY_SOURCE
  notes_for_writer: This is the Special Envoy’s stated assessment of reciprocal regional effects; do not present a more specific causal mechanism.

[VERIFIED] F6: The Special Envoy said Ansar Allah’s threats against Saudi-linked commercial ships in the Red Sea undermined freedom of navigation.
  scope: Saudi-linked commercial ships in the Red Sea
  conditions: 【主体】Ansar Allah, as identified by the Special Envoy
  date_or_period: Reported on 9 October 2026
  causal_strength: CAUSAL_STATED_BY_SOURCE
  notes_for_writer: The source reports threats; it does not say that the ships were attacked. 【背景】The Special Envoy said the threats were becoming enmeshed with a broader confrontation over maritime trade routes and stresses on the international energy market.

[VERIFIED] F7: Hans Grundberg said an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on 10 October killed 12 people and injured more than 300, according to Saudi authorities.
  scope: People affected by the attack at King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh
  conditions: Casualty figures were attributed by the Special Envoy to Saudi authorities. 【主体】Ansar Allah, identified by the Special Envoy as responsible for the attack
  numeric_value: 12 killed; more than 300 injured (numeric_scope: Reported casualties from the 10 October airport attack)
  date_or_period: 10 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: A later GACA statement reported an exact injury total of 309; do not replace this source’s wording with an exact figure when citing this fact. 【背景】The Special Envoy condemned continuing attacks against civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

[VERIFIED] F8: GACA stated that the 10 October attack on King Khalid International Airport resulted in 12 fatalities and left 309 people injured, including individuals in critical condition.
  scope: People affected by the airport attack in Riyadh
  conditions: The statement says injured people were receiving medical care at several hospitals. 【主体】General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), issuing the follow-up statement
  numeric_value: 12 fatalities; 309 injured (numeric_scope: Casualties from the 10 October 2026 attack on King Khalid International Airport)
  date_or_period: 10 October 2026; GACA follow-up statement published 11 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: The statement says the injury total included individuals in critical condition; it does not give the number in critical condition. 【背景】GACA said the extent of property damage was still being assessed.

[VERIFIED] F9: The Special Envoy said attacks earlier in the week on Riyadh and Abha airports had also killed and injured civilians.
  scope: Riyadh and Abha airports; civilian casualties
  conditions: 【主体】Ansar Allah, as identified by the Special Envoy in the statement about continuing attacks
  date_or_period: Earlier in the week of 11 October 2026; exact dates not specified
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: Do not assign the 10 October airport attack’s casualty figures to these earlier attacks.

[VERIFIED] F10: The Media Office of Marib governorate reported that Houthi militias launched nine ballistic missiles and seven other projectiles at several residential neighborhoods in Marib city.
  scope: Several residential neighborhoods in Marib city
  conditions: The report attributes the account to the Media Office of Marib governorate. 【主体】Houthi militias, as named in the report; the reported account is attributed to the Media Office of Marib governorate
  numeric_value: 9 ballistic missiles and 7 other projectiles (numeric_scope: Reported projectiles launched at several residential neighborhoods in Marib city in the incident)
  date_or_period: Evening of 15 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: The body specifies nine ballistic missiles and seven other projectiles; do not describe all 16 as ballistic missiles.

[VERIFIED] F11: Aden’s capital security department said two missiles launched by the Houthi group fell within the grounds of Aden International Airport.
  scope: Within the grounds of Aden International Airport
  conditions: 【主体】The Houthi group, as identified by Aden’s capital security department
  numeric_value: 2 missiles (numeric_scope: Missiles reported to have fallen within the airport grounds in this incident)
  date_or_period: 16 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: The source reports that the missiles fell inside the airport grounds; it does not state that they struck a particular building or aircraft. 【背景】The department described this as the second incident of its kind in less than a week.

[VERIFIED] F12: Aden’s capital security department said preliminary information indicated no loss of life from the 16 October airport incident.
  scope: The incident at Aden International Airport
  conditions: The department described the information as preliminary. 【主体】Aden’s capital security department
  numeric_value: No deaths reported in preliminary information (numeric_scope: Fatalities in the 16 October incident only)
  date_or_period: 16 October 2026
  causal_strength: OBSERVED_REPORTED
  notes_for_writer: Do not convert the statement into a claim that there were no injuries or no damage. 【背景】The department said the relevant authorities were continuing their procedures and that further details would be provided when available.

[VERIFIED] F13: A responsible source in Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Energy said an administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Dhahran was targeted, causing a limited fire; the source said there were no injuries or fatalities.
  scope: One administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
  conditions: The account was reported by Okaz as a statement from a responsible source in the Ministry of Energy.
  numeric_value: 1 administrative building; 0 injuries and 0 fatalities reported (numeric_scope: The building targeted and reported human casualties in this incident)
  date_or_period: Evening of 13 October 2026
  causal_strength: CAUSAL_STATED_BY_SOURCE
  notes_for_writer: Attribute the account and casualty information to the Ministry of Energy source as reported by Okaz; do not infer an attacker. 【背景】The report said the relevant authorities had begun responding to the incident and taking necessary measures.

[VERIFIED] F14: GACA said the attack on King Khalid International Airport caused property damage, the extent of which was still being assessed.
  scope: Property at King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh
  conditions: Extent of damage was under assessment at the time of the statement. 【主体】General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), issuing the follow-up statement
  date_or_period: 10 October 2026; reported 11 October 2026
  causal_strength: CAUSAL_STATED_BY_SOURCE
  notes_for_writer: Do not characterize the amount or severity of property damage beyond the source’s statement.
